label: Lisa Gherardini and Francesco del Giocondo

claims.statement: The Vespucci note links Lisa del Giocondo with a portrait by Leonardo. That the Louvre panel is that portrait rests on later sources and scholarly argument.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Vespucci note, 1503; Vasari.

value.text: Group record of a married couple

claims.statement: This record bundles Lisa and her husband Francesco; see the individual entities.

sources.cite: Inventory structure. Model recall, not checked in this session.

variants: Lisa Gherardini and Francesco del Giocondo (group)
open_questions: Group of two; split recommended. The 1503 date belongs to Lisa's portrait (Vespucci note); Francesco is the presumed commissioner.
